embeds.title: 🔴 Microsoft Patches Two Zero-Day Flaws in Defender
embeds.description:
Microsoft released emergency fixes for two zero-day vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-41091 and CVE-2026-45498) in Microsoft Defender's malware protection components. CVE-2026-41091 is a privilege escalation flaw in mpengine.dll rated CVSS 7.8, while CVE-2026-45498 affects the Microsoft Defender Antimalware Platform. Security experts report the flaws are behind the RedSun and UnDefend exploits published on GitHub by a researcher calling themselves Nightmare Eclipse, though Microsoft has not confirmed these exploit names. CISA added both vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, indicating active exploitation in the wild.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🟢 4 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-41091, CVE-2026-45498, CVE-2026-45584 • **Access:** local
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4175970/microsoft-patches-two-zero-day-flaws-in-defender.html)

embeds.title: 🟡 Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Workload Rated at Maximum Severity
embeds.description:
Cisco disclosed a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-20223) with a CVSS score of 10.0 in the on-premises version of Cisco Secure Workload that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain site admin privileges by sending a crafted HTTP request to an internal REST API endpoint. The vulnerability affects Secure Workload Cluster Software versions 3.9 and earlier, 3.10 (before 3.10.8.3), and 4.0 (before 4.0.3.17). Cisco has already patched the SaaS version and released patches for on-premises deployments. As of the advisory date, Cisco reported no known malicious exploitation in the wild.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-20223 • **Access:** Network - unauthenticated HTTP request to internal REST API endpoint
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** reported
[Read source](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4175913/critical-vulnerability-in-cisco-secure-workload-rated-at-maximum-severity.html)
